Suppose your SL is 5% away. Maximum risk = $5 SL distance = 5% Position size = $5 ÷ 5% = $100 Only after this calculate the leverage according to the margin you want to use. posts.text: CAN THESE CRAZY BULL RUN TARGETS REALLY HAPPEN? Bull markets can push prices far beyond expectations, but market cap matters more than hype. $BTC at $195K, $ETH at $14.6K, and BNB above $3K are aggressive but still within the realm of a powerful bull cycle. $SOL at $2,300+ and HYPE near $859 would require extremely large capital inflows. The mistake many traders make is looking only at price. Always calculate: Target Price × Circulating Supply = Required Market Cap In a bull run, anything can pump hard but tokenomics and market cap tell you whether the target actually makes sense.

posts.text: $XAU time for sell, open big short now and make money with me entry 4135-4165 sl 4180 tp 4099-4050 Short $XAU 👇 {future}(XAUUSDT) Why did $XAU and $BTC sell off together on Oct 7? On the surface, these two markets look completely unrelated. But underneath, they can react to the same macro pressure. A stronger USD, rising US yields, and Brent pushing above $100 all mean tighter financial conditions and less risk appetite. Gold gets pressured because it doesn’t generate yield. Bitcoin gets pressured because it’s still trading more like a risk asset, with leverage making the move even sharper. Bottom line: when yields and the USD rise together, the market is repricing the real cost of capital and the possibility that the Fed stays restrictive for longer.

posts.text: 21shares published a digital-asset allocation analysis examining Bitcoin, Ethereum and Solana in traditional investment portfolios. After tax tokens were sold, the contract called controlburn() and sync(), reducing the pool’s recorded TENDRIL reserves to nearly zero before the seller’s remaining tokens entered the pool. The attacker then used subsequent swaps to withdraw nearly all remaining USDT from the pool. The attacker used about 30.64 million USDT in flash-loan funds to manipulate the pool’s price and reserves, withdrew about 4.42 million USDT, and repaid the loan in the same transaction. posts.text: According to CNBC, LIV Golf could face liquidation after BC Partners Credit reportedly withdrew a plan to finance a relaunch of the league. The firm had pledged up to $300 million for LIV 2.0 but dropped the plan after LIV failed to secure enough player commitments, according to the Associated Press. LIV is scheduled to appear in U.S. bankruptcy court Thursday, where the hearing is now expected to focus on liquidating its assets. posts.text: Hong Kong plans an interbank tokenized gold trading project in which each token would correspond to one standard 400-ounce gold bar. According to Odaily, Secretary for Financial Services and the Treasury Christopher Hui said at Hong Kong FinTech Week that the project would be advanced through the Hong Kong Monetary Authority’s Ensemble project. The initiative is expected to use the Hong Kong gold reference price, HAU, as its pricing benchmark, and Hong Kong plans new arrangements for tokenized deposits to support the project. Hui also said Hong Kong Exchanges and Clearing plans to build a blockchain-based, multi-asset tokenization platform that would allow pilot trading of tokenized carbon credits. In 2027, the pilot is expected to include warehouse receipts backed by goods stored in Hong Kong warehouses recognized by the London Metal Exchange.

posts.text: According to ChainCatcher citing Phoenix Net Tech, Moonshot AI announced on November 5 that it had released the Kimi K3.1 Pro model weights on Hugging Face. posts.text: Fidelity macro director Jurrien Timmer doubts the 60/40 portfolio is back: five-year stock-bond correlation is 10%-12%. The reading uses data through November 2, according to BeInCrypto, and Timmer says higher yields keep stocks and bonds moving together. Short-term correlation fell or turned negative in the 1998 growth scare, dot-com bust and 2025 tariff tantrum, while the five-year regime stayed positive. Treasuries rallied during October’s AI stock selloff; Ariel Investments’ Charlie Bobrinskoy sees bonds as worth buying with 10-year yields around 5%. posts.text: India’s Computer Emergency Response Team (CERT-In) on Wednesday designated AI-assisted attackers targeting financial institutions as “CRAFTY FALCON” and updated a warning first issued last October. According to Odaily, the latest notice explicitly identifies cryptocurrency exchanges as targets and says the activity is continuing to escalate. CERT-In said attackers exploit vulnerable applications and exposed test environments, using shared credentials and access tokens to enter production systems and deploy malicious files on cloud infrastructure. AI tools help them quickly generate and refine attack scripts, with some operations scheduled for weekends and holidays to delay detection. The agency said attackers used small test transactions to check unauthorized transfers, then stole cryptocurrency wallet keys and moved funds. CERT-In did not identify affected exchanges or disclose losses.

posts.text: According to ChainCatcher, Hyperliquid HIP-3 market deployer Paragon has launched Power Perps, with its first product, HYPE-squared, tracking the square of HYPE’s price. The perpetual contracts have no strike price or expiry date and track an underlying asset’s price raised to a power. Paragon says a doubling in the underlying price would make a squared index four times its starting value, while a cubed index would rise eightfold. The design draws on Power Perpetuals proposed by Dan Robinson, Dave White and Andrew Leone, and on Opyn’s Squeeth, which brought ETH-squared perpetual convexity to Uniswap v3. Paragon said Hyperliquid’s order book, spot and linear perpetual markets, and portfolio margin allow market makers to hedge Power Perps exposure. Paragon has previously launched perpetual markets on Hyperliquid tracking Bitcoin dominance, TOTAL2 and OTHERS.

posts.text: The Ethereum Foundation has outlined a fork-by-fork roadmap to achieve Lean Ethereum by 2029, with the H* fork set to be the last without Lean features. The rules will take effect on November 13, alongside amendments to the Capital Markets Act. posts.text: South Korea’s Financial Services Commission said on November 5 that it will draft guidance requiring virtual asset service providers to immediately notify the Financial Supervisory Service and the Financial Security Institute after discovering a security incident. According to Odaily, these firms currently only need to report such incidents to the Korea Internet & Security Agency. Financial authorities also plan to draft a Digital Financial Security Act that would apply security requirements comparable to those in the Electronic Financial Transactions Act to virtual asset service providers, insurance agencies, lending businesses and other industries holding substantial customer information or posing a risk of significant asset losses. They plan to complete the legislative work and submit a bill in the first quarter of 2027.

posts.text: The Ethereum Economic Zone (EEZ) released the Rollup X developer testnet at Devcon 8 to demonstrate synchronous composability. According to Odaily, Gnosis and Zisk co-founded EEZ, which received funding from the Ethereum Foundation. EEZ aims to connect applications on dedicated chains through Ethereum-neutral infrastructure, enabling contracts on EEZ rollups or Ethereum mainnet to call another contract atomically in a single transaction. ETH is the default gas token, and the system does not introduce a new token. A Swiss nonprofit governs EEZ, whose consortium members include Aave, Safe, and Centrifuge.

posts.text: ZetaChain has submitted its second governance proposal on migrating ZETA to Solana, and voting is now open. According to Odaily, the plan calls for monthly burns totaling about 55 million ZETA in 2027 and for the foundation not to sell newly unlocked ZETA allocated to it that year. The proposed migration is scheduled for December 9, 2026, at a 1:1 ratio, subject to governance approval. The vote will run for 72 hours and end on November 7. After the migration, ZETA would no longer be issued, and its minting authority would be permanently revoked.

posts.text: DTCC’s tokenization service currently runs on Canton Network and DTCC’s private Besu network, with plans to support more blockchains in 2027. According to Odaily, Morgan Stanley has tokenized U.S. stocks and Treasuries through the service, which converts securities held by the Depository Trust Company (DTC) into digital twins that can be converted back into securities while retaining ownership rights, investor protections and economic interests. Twenty DTC participants have signed up, including Bank of America, Citigroup, JPMorgan Chase, Fidelity, Citadel Securities and UBS. DTCC said the service was developed with input from more than 150 institutions. The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission issued DTC a no-action letter in December 2025 allowing it to tokenize Russell 1000 constituent stocks, major index ETFs and U.S. Treasuries.

posts.text: Dine Brands reported a 15% increase in third-quarter revenue, while profit declined amid higher costs. According to Sina Finance, net income was $4.6 million, or $0.37 per share, compared with $7.3 million, or $0.48 per share, in the same period last year. Adjusted earnings per share, excluding one-time items, were $0.82, below FactSet-surveyed analysts’ expectation of $1.01. Revenue reached $248.9 million, exceeding Wall Street’s estimate of $239.7 million. The company said growth mainly came from acquisitions and newly opened company-operated restaurants over the past year. Total operating costs rose 25%, while general and administrative expenses increased 2.8%, partly because of higher professional services and labor-related costs. posts.text: Kraft Heinz shares rose 5.3% in early trading after the company raised its full-year sales outlook. According to Sina Finance, Kraft Heinz now expects organic net sales to decline 0.5% to 1.3%, compared with its previous guidance for a decline of as much as 2%, and raised its adjusted earnings-per-share forecast to $2.07-$2.13 from $2.03-$2.09. The company said its transformation plan was making progress. CEO Steve Cahillane said efforts to transform its U.S. business and accelerate overseas growth were on track, with market share, sales and shipment trends improving across all regions compared with last year. Third-quarter net income fell to $544 million, or $0.46 per share, from $615 million, or $0.52 per share, a year earlier. posts.text: Binance co-CEO Richard Teng said the exchange’s latest Proof of Reserves snapshot now covers 44 tokens, up from 10, so users can independently verify that more of their assets are backed at least 1:1.Generating the full zero-knowledge proof takes 50 to 60 hours of computation. Teng said the wait serves an important purpose: “letting users verify the backing of their own balances, rather than simply taking our word for it.”Binance has now replenished about 98% of impacted assets, Teng said. The exchange is buying the remaining, less liquid tokens “carefully through market and OTC channels to avoid moving prices as we close the gap.”Binance’s next steps are fully reopening withdrawals and strengthening safeguards, he said, adding that he will keep sharing progress.

posts.text: According to CNBC, President Donald Trump blamed Fox News for Republican losses in posts on Truth Social Tuesday night as Democrats took control of both the Senate and House of Representatives. He cited the network’s ratings, which Fox News reported averaged 1.1 million viewers in October, down about 27% from a year earlier. Fox Corp. CEO Lachlan Murdoch attributed the decline to viewer fatigue and said such a shift was expected ahead of a midterm election with a second-term president. Fox Corp. reported fiscal first-quarter revenue of $4.57 billion, up 22% year over year, while advertising revenue rose 47%.

posts.text: According to ChainCatcher, Sequoia Capital outlined a series of changes in an essay titled “The Sequoia of Tomorrow,” published on X one year after its generational transition. The firm said it will focus on high-conviction, highly selective venture investing, simplify its fund structure, discontinue the Arc batch accelerator and Scouts programs, and streamline its operations and investment teams. Sequoia is merging its early- and growth-stage teams into one and will close its London office, with some employees departing; it will support European founders from its San Francisco Bay Area headquarters. The firm has also flattened its partnership structure and ended its weekly Monday partner meetings. It said it has raised about $10 billion in new funds. The company said it had repeatedly tried to discuss a potential deal privately with Helen of Troy's board, but that the board had not engaged in substantive discussions. David Maura, Spectrum Brands' CEO and Empower Brands' chairman, said Helen of Troy was trying to block the acquisition process by demanding an agreement with overly restrictive terms that would prevent Empower Brands from disclosing its offer to Helen of Troy shareholders. posts.text: According to Jin10, this winter is expected to be the warmest on record in the United States, sharply reducing natural gas demand and consumers' use of gas for heating and power generation. The strengthening El Niño is driving the most pessimistic expectations among traders in the U.S. natural gas market since the COVID-19 pandemic. U.S. gas producers and traders holding bullish positions were already hurt by El Niño in October. Matt Rogers, president of Commodity Weather Group, said October was the third-warmest October on record since 1950 based on gas-weighted heating degree days. He said the trend is expected to intensify this month, with November likely to become the warmest on record by a clear margin. posts.text: Liquid’s reserves have been restored, with 4,270.54 BTC backing an equal amount of L-BTC, according to SideSwap. According to Odaily, an attacker exploited a vulnerability in Elements’ rangeproof validation on September 6 to mint about 4,000 L-BTC without bitcoin reserves, reducing reserves from about 4,205 BTC to 197 BTC. Most of the tokens were returned, and a November 2 deposit of 250 BTC filled the remaining gap. Direct redemption through the federation remains restricted, so users must exit through swap providers.
